summary: Challenge to High Court judgment setting aside Standing Order No. 01/2022; validity of Auroville Foundation Act, 1988 examined; role and powers of Governing Board under Sections 10, 11, 17 upheld; primacy of statutory framework over internal disputes; High Court interference unjustified; appeal allowed to extent of restoring statutory authority of Foundation.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; impugned judgment of Madras High Court modified; powers of Governing Board under the Auroville Foundation Act, 1988 upheld; Standing Order No. 01/2022 validly issued.
